text: God already knows how this story ends — and it ends in hope.
bibleVerseText: For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.

text: The God of hope is still filling me — even now, even here.
bibleVerseText: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him, so that you may overflow with hope by the power of the Holy Spirit.

text: Every year I've waited is being woven into something good.
bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

text: When I'm too tired to lift my head, God lifts it for me.
bibleVerseText: But you, Lord, are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

text: God is faithful — not because I feel it, but because He said it.
bibleVerseText: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

text: I have been waiting long enough — and God renews the ones who wait.
bibleVerseText: But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles.

text: I will still see God's goodness — in this life, not just the next.
bibleVerseText: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

text: My soul is anchored — even when I can't feel the bottom.
bibleVerseText: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.

text: What God is building now will be greater than what I have lost.
bibleVerseText: The glory of this present house will be greater than the glory of the former house, says the Lord Almighty.

text: After all this waiting, hope has not put me to shame.
bibleVerseText: And hope does not put us to shame, because God's love has been poured out into our hearts.

text: My heart is still beating — and so is my hope.
bibleVerseText: Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the Lord.

text: What tried to bury me is being turned into my breakthrough.
bibleVerseText: You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good to accomplish what is now being done.

text: God has walked with me through every single day of this wait.
bibleVerseText: Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid or terrified because of them, for the Lord your God goes with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you.

text: When I have nothing left, I have God's word — and it holds.
bibleVerseText: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.

text: I am still faithful in prayer — and that is not nothing.
bibleVerseText: Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.

text: Even in the long dark, God is my light — and He doesn't dim.
bibleVerseText: The Lord is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear?

text: I am a prisoner of hope — locked to what God promised to restore.
bibleVerseText: Return to your fortress, you prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.

text: These years are not lost — they are building glory I cannot yet see.
bibleVerseText: For our light and momentary troubles are achieving for us an eternal glory that far outweighs them all.

text: God started something in me and He is still finishing it — today.
bibleVerseText: Being confident of this, that he who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion.

text: Every need I have is already held in the hands of God.
bibleVerseText: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

text: I woke up today, and God's mercy showed up first.
bibleVerseText: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed... his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

text: I do not have to carry tomorrow — God is already there.
bibleVerseText: Therefore do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will worry about itself.

text: Hope is my helmet — it guards my mind on the darkest days.
bibleVerseText: But since we belong to the day, let us be sober, putting on faith and love as a breastplate, and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

text: What I'm waiting for is more real than what I see right now.
bibleVerseText: So we fix our eyes not on what is seen, but on what is unseen, since what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.

text: My hope is alive — raised from the dead like Jesus Himself.
bibleVerseText: In his great mercy he has given us new birth into a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead.

text: God will restore twice what the long years took from me.
bibleVerseText: Return to your fortress, you prisoners of hope; even now I announce that I will restore twice as much to you.

text: The morning is coming — God said so, and God doesn't lie.
bibleVerseText: Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

text: The anchor of my soul is firm — even in this storm.
bibleVerseText: We have this hope as an anchor for the soul, firm and secure.

text: I remain confident — I will see God's goodness before this life ends.
bibleVerseText: I remain confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

text: Hope is not running out — it is overflowing by the power of the Spirit.
bibleVerseText: May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in him.
